title: Exercise final handoff fencing and healthy delivery for every ACP vendor
outcome: Add deterministic ordinary final-handoff controls for Cursor, Gemini, OpenCode and Kimi, preserving each vendor's existing Stop semantics and proving healthy enqueue as well as stale owner/Stop refusal. Distinguish executable per-vendor evidence from common-arm source audit.
acceptance: Exercise final handoff fencing and healthy delivery for every ACP vendor is done
